title: Dodocool 4 Port USB Travel Wall Charger with Universal AC Power Adapter DA47
categoryName: Cell Phones & Accessories:Cell Phone Accessories:Chargers & Cradles
descriptionText:
Model:DA47US
Input: 100-240V- 0.45A 50-60Hz 
Total USB Output: 5V==4A 20W Max
Each USB Output:5V=-2.4A Max
RoHS

Introducing the Dodocool 4 Port USB Travel Wall Charger with Universal AC Outlet Power Adapter - the perfect solution for all your charging needs! With its compact design and multiple ports, you can easily charge your devices wherever you go. The adapter is compatible with a wide range of brands and comes in a sleek white color.

Ideal for those who are always on the go, this power adapter is a must-have accessory for your cell phone. It features a universal AC outlet that allows you to charge your device quickly and efficiently. With its 5 ports, you can easily charge multiple devices at once, making it the perfect solution for those who need to charge their phone, tablet, and other devices all at once.
